name: Harmony Express
source:
Detective, you've just been called in for the biggest case of your life.

The Harmony Express, England's most luxurious train, has been robbed of the priceless art it was transporting. The train is filled with colourful personalities, and every single one of them is a suspect.

[from [url=https://octopus8studios.itch.io/harmony-express]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
侦探，你刚刚被叫去处理你一生中最大的案件。

和谐快车是英国最豪华的列车，它所运输的无价艺术品却被抢走了。火车上挤满了形形色色的人物，每个人都是犯罪嫌疑人。

[来自[url=https://octopus8studios.itch.io/harmony-express]itch.io[/url]]
